analysis:
The supplied PR change is documentation only: CHANGELOG.md adds an "Unreleased - KV admission estimates" entry at head lines 1-10 (patch hunk @@ -1,4 +1,10 @@). The base_text units show surrounding changelog content. No source, config or test files are in the supplied units, so I could not verify the implementation behind the entry.

The entry describes three behaviors: (1) reducing ordinary engine concurrency when fixed recurrent or MTP workspace would consume the KV grant; (2) estimating cold-model KV cost from fresh native reports for the same artifact and verified runtime instead of the generic bytes-per-token fallback; (3) sharing cold-rate evidence once per fleet sample and avoiding registry read leases that span donor walks.

Security relevance, if implemented as described: item (2) consumes provider-reported native reports for routing/admission estimates. Those reports come from adversarial providers (ADV-001, TB-002). The entry says live slot budgets stay authoritative and provider memory checks still decide fit. The code review should confirm that provider-reported evidence cannot bias coordinator routing or admission. It should also confirm that it cannot bypass the final authorization at authorizeInferenceHandoff, TB-002/TB-011/T-053, or the dispatch gates providerSupportsPrivateTextAuthorizationAtLocked and providerLivenessGateReasonLocked. Item (3) changes locking around registry scans; confirm that revocation and expiry checks are still made under the proper locks at final dispatch.

No security regression, new attack surface or threat-model invalidation is visible in the changelog text alone. The implementation was not supplied, so this is a coverage limit rather than evidence of safety. No findings are reported.
